production.note: US model years 1969-1970. Quote (Silodrome, Ben Branch): "Production totaled about 1,359 cars—859 in 1969 and 499 in 1970". Encycarpedia: production years 1969, 1970 (encycarpedia-boss-429).

transmission.note: "Every Boss 429 came with a close-ratio Toploader 4-speed manual".

powerHp.note: PROVISIONAL (articles and a database, no Ford document opened). Manufacturer rating as published in the period: SAE gross (pre-1972 US practice; powerStandard "Other"). Quote (Silodrome, Ben Branch): "Ford rated the 429 V8 at 375 bhp and 450 lb-ft". Supercars.net (Nick Dellis): "279.6 kw / 374.9 bhp @ 5200 rpm" (supercars-boss-429). Encycarpedia: "375 BHP @ 5,200 RPM" (encycarpedia-boss-429).

weightLb.note: PROVISIONAL (enthusiast page and a database). Quote (Supercars.net, Nick Dellis, 1969 Boss 429): "Curb Weight | 1601 kg / 3530 lbs". Encycarpedia: "Kerb Weight 1,590 kg" = 3,505 lb (encycarpedia-boss-429), 0.7% lower. 4-speed manual (the only transmission).

provisionalNote: Power (375 hp SAE gross) rests on Silodrome, Supercars.net and Encycarpedia, agreeing; weight (3,530 lb) rests on Supercars.net and Encycarpedia (3,505 lb), 0.7% apart. A Ford 1969 specification or a major magazine spec panel for the Boss 429 would replace them.
